title: Beige & Maroon Floral Hand Block Print Cotton Kurta Pant Set with Kota Doria Dupatta
color_custom: Earthy beige with maroon & brown floral block print
description:
Mitti means earth – warm, grounded and timeless, like the colours of a Rajasthani afternoon.

A soft beige cotton kurta, hand block printed in Jaipur with flowering maroon vines and brown leaves. The sweetheart neckline gives it a graceful, feminine touch, the straight cut with side slits is easy to move in, and the 3/4 sleeves are finished with a printed border. It comes with matching block print cotton pants with a floral border at the hem, and a light Kota Doria dupatta, hand block printed in the same tones and finished with tassels.

✦ The Details
• Sweetheart neckline
• Straight kurta with side slits, calf length
• 3/4 sleeves with a printed border
• All-over maroon floral hand block print
• Cotton pants with a hand block printed border at the hem
• Kota Doria dupatta, hand block printed, with tassels
• 3-piece set: kurta, pants and dupatta

✦ Fabric & Craft
Breathable cotton, hand block printed in Jaipur – every flower is stamped by hand with carved wooden blocks, so tiny variations in colour and alignment are part of the craft. The dupatta is Kota Doria, a light, airy weave with its signature small checks, from Kota in Rajasthan.

✦ Fit & Size
Regular fit. Choose your usual size or use our Fit Finder. Between sizes? Size up – or send us your bust, waist and hip and we will stitch it to your measurements.

✦ How to Style It
Gold hoops, a stack of bangles and brown leather juttis for office or a lunch; add oxidised jhumkas and a small bindi for a festive day. Abroad, a camel coat or cream cardigan sits beautifully with these earthy tones.

✦ The Bahe Promise
• Made in Jaipur – we send you photos of your piece before it ships
• Free custom fit on request – share your measurements
• Free worldwide shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE & Australia – duties & taxes included, with tracking
• Real people on WhatsApp to help with size and styling

Every hand block printed piece is unique. The colour may look slightly different on your screen.
set_items: Pants (cotton, hand block print with printed border)
Dupatta (Kota Doria, hand block print, tassels)
care: Hand wash separately in cold water with a mild detergent – natural block print colours may bleed a little in the first wash. Dry inside out in shade. Iron on medium heat on the reverse side. Hand wash the Kota Doria dupatta gently and do not wring.
